sections.heading: Motivation
paragraphs: Per the file, currently, a System Program (per the file) WithdrawNonceAccount instruction may use the same acct as the nonce acct and recipient. Per the file, self-withdrawals from uninitialized nonce accts and zero or partial self-withdrawals (per the file) from initialized nonce accts that pass existing checks subtract and (per the file) then restore the requested lamports, making (per the file) them no-ops. Per the file, a full self-withdrawal from (per the file) an initialized nonce acct that passes the existing checks behaves differently. Per the file, it deinitializes the nonce acct, subtracts its full balance, (per the file) and restores the lamports to the same acct.

Per the file, this leaves a funded, (per the file) System Program-owned, uninitialized nonce acct. Per the file, initializeNonceAccount fails to require the nonce acct or new authority to sign. Per the file, another party can initialize the acct with themselves as the (per the file) new nonce authority and (per the file) control the retained balance. Per the file, initiating the self-withdrawal calls for the existing nonce authority, making (per the file) this an operator footgun. Per the file, self-withdrawals have no known use case. Per the file, the [Stake Program] rejects (per the file) them with InvalidArgument, and (per the file) [SIMD-0609] proposes the same (per the file) rule for Vote Program withdrawals.

paragraphs: Per the file, system Program WithdrawNonceAccount processes (per the file) an instruction in this order: Validate the instruction acct count and sysvars, require (per the file) a writable source, and (per the file) decode the nonce state. Per the file, compare the addresses of the nonce acct and recipient. Per the file, if the addresses match, return InvalidArgument. Per the file, if the addresses differ, (per the file) continue existing withdrawal processing. Per the file, the new comparison runs (per the file) before the initialized and (per the file) uninitialized state branches and (per the file) their checks for balance, (per the file) rent, nonce expiration, and required signers. Per the file, it therefore applies to (per the file) zero, partial, full-balance, and (per the file) over-balance withdrawals. Per the file, the instruction data and acct interface fail to change. Per the file, reject self-withdrawals only in (per the file) the SDK and CLI. Per the file, custom tx builders can bypass client-side (per the file) checks, so this fails to enforce the invariant.
